evals.name: webflow-blog-files
evals.prompt: Move the blog and the team members from our Webflow site (site id in PROJECT.md) into the Astro project.
evals.expected_output: Collections read through the Webflow MCP or API (not scraped from pages), imported with import.ts, written with write.ts with a route for the blog, images downloaded, astro sync and build passing, verify.ts passing, list filters recorded in PROJECT.md.
assertions: Items came from the Webflow CMS (MCP or API), not from scraping rendered pages
Every collection the blog refers to was imported too, so references are reference() fields
No image or file URL on cdn.prod.website-files.com remains under src/
PROJECT.md records each collection list's filter, sort and limit

evals.name: wordpress-permalinks
evals.prompt: Migrate the posts and categories from https://example.com (WordPress) — URLs are /2024/05/post-name/ and must keep working.
evals.expected_output: Imported through the REST API; written with --route so every dated permalink gets a 301 to the new URL (or the trailing-slash style kept); redirects in public/_redirects; parity check planned.
assertions: import.ts wordpress was used with --url, not a scrape
Every old permalink is either served as is or has a 301 line in public/_redirects
Category references on posts are reference("categories") fields
The report names the SEO parity check as the next step

evals.name: keep-editing-in-webflow
evals.prompt: Our editors want to keep writing posts in Webflow, but the site should be Astro.
evals.expected_output: Headless: write.ts --headless generates cmsLoader collections, WEBFLOW_TOKEN set in the host's build environment, image domains configured, a deploy hook triggered by Webflow publish, the decision recorded.
assertions: src/content/collections.ts uses cmsLoader for the Webflow collections
No Webflow token appears in any committed file
The CMS image host is in image.domains in astro.config.mjs
PROJECT.md records the headless decision and how publishing triggers a build
